page.overview:
Who is Shigeko?

Shigeko serves as one of the Japanese fan dancers for the World Grand Prix welcome party in Tokyo, wearing the traditional geisha outfit, along with two other similar cars.

In the film, when The Team McQueen arrived to japan, She appeared with Okuni and Tamiko at the Kabuki Za Theatre dancing, later they appeared at the Tokyo National Art Center and finally appeared at the Tokyo Imperial Palace for the Tokyo Grand Prix for the World Grand Prix.
